usedFor: Xero holds the bills, payments and quotes, HubSpot receives them as deals, and “New Quote” can start “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in Xero, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A quote created in Xero opens a deal in HubSpot.

watchOut: Every Xero trigger here is polling, so “New Payment” reaches HubSpot on a schedule, not at once.
